markers.title: Hermit Merchant's Shack
markers.desc: Sites of Grace at the Hermit Merchant's Shack.

markers.title: Hermit Merchant's Shack
markers.desc: Found within the outskirts of Leyndell, Ashen Capital. It can be found atop a cliff, just inside the capital's outermost wall.

markers.title: Minor Erdtree
markers.desc: Minor Erdtree within the Capital Outskirts.

markers.title: Auriza Side Tomb
markers.desc: A catacomb at the east-most area of Leyndell, Ashen Capital for fallen Auriza warriors

markers.title: Auriza Side Tomb
markers.desc: Site of Grace within Auriza Side Tomb.

markers.title: Capital Rampart
markers.desc: Site of grace at the Ashen Capital's rampart.

markers.title: Auriza Hero's Grave
markers.desc: A tomb found within the outskirts of the Ashen Capital. Larger than most catacombs, this was built to honor a fallen champion and is heavily guarded to this day.

markers.title: Auriza Hero's Grave
markers.desc: Site of Grace within Auriza Hero's Grave.

markers.title: Crimson Amber Medallion
markers.desc: Crimson Amber Medallion +2. Held by a corpse hanging over one of the wooden beams on your way down.

markers.title: Frenzied Flame Proscription
markers.desc: Site of Grace underneath the Cathedral of the Forsaken Site of Grace. Behind the altar at the Cathedral of the Forsaken is an illusory wall. Upon descending to the bottom of the accessed pit the ground collapses, leaving you next to the Frenzied Flame Proscription Site of Grace.

markers.title: Leyndell, Ashen Capital
markers.desc: An instance of Leyndell, Royal Capital after it falls into ruins. This version of the capital is accessible only after making significant story progress and features the same structures and landmarks as its intact counterpart, albeit altered in slight or significant ways.

markers.title: East Capital Rampart
markers.desc: Site of Grace at the East side of Leyndell.

markers.title: Cathedral of the Forsaken
markers.desc: Site of Grace at the Cathedral of the Forsaken.

markers.title: Leyndell, Capital of Ash
markers.desc: Site of Grace within the obliterated city.

markers.title: Forbiden Lands
markers.desc: Site of Grace at the beginning of the path connecting Altus Plateau with the Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.title: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
markers.desc: A massive underground sewer network found beneath the Ashen Capital. The entrance can be found in a well northeast of the Avenue Balcony.

markers.title: Underground Roadside
markers.desc: Site of Grace found underground within Subterranean Shunning-Grounds.

markers.title: Great Waterfall Crest
markers.desc: Site of grace, directly after leaving the resting coffin.

markers.title: Ulcerated Tree Spirit
markers.desc: 3 Ulcerated Tree Spirits can be found romaing around this deserted sand area, it's convinient to try to encouter them one at a time.

markers.title: Crucible Scale Talisman
markers.desc: Within the chapel accessed by using one of the flame throwing sculptures as a lift. Located next to the statue guarded by an Omen.

markers.title: Leyndell Catacombs
markers.desc: Site of Grace within Leyndell Catacombs.

markers.title: Rune Arc - Eastern Rampart
markers.desc: Held by a burnt corpse sitting against one of the ruined structures.

markers.title: Erdtree's Favor +2
markers.desc: Upgraded Talisman. This Talisman may only be accessed near endgame/post-game. Found on top of a branch jutting out of the ground in a large courtyard, guarded by three Ulcerated Tree Spirits.

markers.title: Grave Glovewort [9] - Leyndell Catacombs
markers.desc: Located within Leyndell Catacombs, in one of the main halls with a large statue. Guarded by an Omen.

markers.title: Ghost Glovewort [6] - Leyndell Catacombs
markers.desc: Beyond the stairs southeast of the door leading to the Bossfight, in front of a statue guarded by Skeletons.

markers.title: Grave Glovewort [8] - 2x Leyndell Catacombs
markers.desc: The first Grave Glovewort [8] is found over the central grave in one of the main halls. The second one is in front of a large statue following the stairs southeast from the first Grave Glovewort.

markers.title: Golden Sunflower
markers.desc: Held by a burnt corpse laying against one of the ruined buildings.

markers.title: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone (Ashen Capital)
markers.desc: From the main Leyndell, Capital of Ash Site of Grace, go west, along the dragon. Enter the building past it and climb the ladder. Over the railing to the right is an enemy gargoyle, guarding a corpse with the stone.

markers.title: Brother Corhyn
markers.desc: At the end of his Questline, Brother Corhyn is found on his knees in sorrow, near the base of the giant spiral spear. After reloading the area, you can find Corhyn's Bell Bearing and Corhyn's Robe where he was sitting.

markers.title: Erdtree Heal
markers.desc: Found on the large covered furniture within Queen's Bedchamber, next to the Site of Grace.

markers.title: Valiant Gargoyle
markers.desc: Endgame Boss. Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.title: Queen's Bedchamber
markers.desc: Site of Grace at the Queen's Bedchamber.

markers.title: Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing
markers.desc:
Great Enemy Boss
Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing Bossfight takes place at the Erdtree Sanctuary building. Once leader of Roundtable Hold, Sir Gideon Ofnir masters a wide range of powerful sorceries and incantations.

markers.title: Effigy of the Martyr: Elden Throne
markers.desc: Summoning Pool Effigy found on the bridge just before Godfrey's Boss Arena in Leyndell, Capital of Ash. Activate this effigy to send your summon sign to this summoning pool.

markers.title: All-Knowing Set
markers.desc:
Dropped together with Scepter of the All-Knowing upon defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

Comprised of:

  • All-Knowing Helm
  • All-Knowing Armor
  • All-Knowing Gauntlets
  • All-Knowing Greaves

markers.title: Scepter of the All-Knowing
markers.desc: Dropped together with the All-Knowing Set upon defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

markers.title: Remembrance of Hoarah Loux
markers.desc: Dropped by Godfrey, First Elden Lord (Hoarah Loux, Warrior) when defeated.

markers.title: Ritual Shield Talisman
markers.desc: Ritual Shield Talisman held by a corpse, next to the large Colloseum doors.

markers.title: Erdtree Sanctuary
markers.desc: This Site of Grace is unlocked upon Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing's defeat.

markers.title: Elden Throne Site of Grace
markers.desc: Site of Grace for the Elden Throne. Unlocked upon Godfrey, First Elden Lord's defeat.

markers.title: Godfrey, First Elden Lord
markers.desc:
Legend Type Boss
Located in the chamber atop the long set of stairs southeast of the Queen's Bedchamber Site of Grace where Morgott was previously fought. Mid-battle, Godfrey assumes the role of Hoarah Loux, Warrior.

markers.title: Effigy of the Martyr: Erdtree Sanctuary
markers.desc: Summoning Pool Effigy found just before Sir Gideon Ofnir, The All-Knowing's boss arena in Leyndell, Capital of Ash. Activate this effigy to send your summon sign to this summoning pool.

markers.title: Goldmask's Set
markers.desc: After the completion of Brother Corhyn's questline. Head south from the Capital of Ash site of grace and go down the small path in the direction of the colosseum. Go past the plant enemies and stick to the left and you will find Goldmask. Look the rune from him, and reset the area and return to find the rest of his set on his body.

markers.title: Divine Tower of East Altus: Gates
markers.desc: Site of Grace at the gates of the Divine Tower of East Altus.

markers.title: Effigy of the Martyr: Elden Beast
markers.desc: Summoning Pool Effigy found just before the Elden Beast boss arena in Leyndell, Capital of Ash. Activate this effigy to send your summon sign to this summoning pool.

markers.title: Divine Tower of East Altus
markers.desc: Found at the very east of the Leyndell, Ashen Capital region. Seen last before accessing to the Forbidden Lands.

markers.title: Divine Tower of East Altus
markers.desc: Site of Grace for the Divine Tower of East Altus.

markers.title: Staff of the Avatar
markers.desc: Staff dropped by a Lesser Erdtree Avatar.

markers.title: Ash of War: Golden Land
markers.desc: Dropped from a Teardrop Scarab

markers.title: Ghost Glovewort [4]
markers.desc: Found on the hill, near a yellowish small tree.

markers.title: Radagon of the Golden Order
markers.desc:
God Type Boss
Final Boss. Once Radagon of the Golden Order is defeated, Elden Beast, the true form of the Elden Ring, must be fought.

markers.title: Elden Remembrance
markers.desc: Dropped by the Elden Beast upon defeat.

markers.title: Fractured Marika
markers.desc:
This

Site of Grace

is unlocked once the

Radagon of the Golden Order

and the

Elden Beast

Bossfight

is successfully completed.
